items.name: Away The Large
items.detail: Everything you don't need until a hotel room. It goes into the hold, onto the cabin floor of the Z165, and into the tour van — and it stays behind in Shigatse on base camp night.

items.name: Osprey Talon 44 (S/M)
items.detail: Your cabin bag on every flight, your bunk bag for thirty hours on the train, and — the reason it earns its place — your overnight bag at 5,200 m.

items.name: Osprey daypack
items.spec: Personal item · pick the 20–26 L one
items.detail: The city bag: the Xi'an wall, Lhasa monasteries, and full days at Shanghai Disneyland. It folds flat into the Talon on the base camp leg.

items.name: REI Ruckpack Waistpack
items.spec: On you · 3 L · 6.6 oz · worn crossbody
items.detail: Passport, permit, phone, cash, meds, a small power bank. Worn on the front, never checked, never handed over. If everything else went missing you would still be fine.

items.name: ATL → LAX → ICN → Xi'an
items.detail: Away checked through. Talon in the cabin, under 7 kg. Daypack as the personal item — the two together must come in under 10 kg. Sling worn on your body, which nobody counts. Boots, hardshell and watch on you.

items.name: Xi'an, three nights
items.detail: Away opens once in the hotel room and stays there. Daypack and sling do the wall, the Terracotta Army and the Muslim Quarter.

items.name: Z165, thirty hours
items.detail: This is the repack that matters. Everything for thirty hours goes into the Talon, which comes up onto the bunk: sleepwear, sandals, toothbrush, wipes, food, mug, power bank, earplugs. The Away goes on the cabin floor and you do not open it again until Lhasa.

items.name: Lhasa, three nights
items.detail: Away in the hotel. Daypack for the monasteries. Rent or buy the parka and, if you want it, the sleeping bag here — around Barkhor, before the tour leaves for Shigatse.

items.name: Shigatse → base camp
items.detail: The Away stays behind. The Talon becomes the overnight bag: the EBC cube, the parka, the sleeping kit, everything electronic fully charged. The daypack folds flat inside it. Sling stays on you.

items.name: Lhasa → Shanghai, then Disney
items.detail: The 20 kg domestic limit bites here — weigh the Away before you leave the hotel. If the Talon has to be checked on that sector, move the power banks and the medication into the sling first; lithium cannot go in the hold. In Shanghai the daypack is the park bag and the sling is what you keep on for TRON.

items.name: Xi'an
items.detail: Mild autumn, a fair chance of rain. Golden Week starts 1 Oct — expect crowds everywhere.

items.name: Z165 soft sleeper
items.detail: Thirty hours. Dry air, piped oxygen at the berths, boiling water in every carriage.

items.name: Lhasa & Shigatse
items.detail: Dry and bright by day, near freezing after dark. UV is the real hazard, not the cold.

items.name: Everest Base Camp
items.detail: One tent night. Wind, no shower, no power, pit toilets, yak-dung stove.

items.name: Shanghai & Disney
items.detail: Mild and drying out, and after Golden Week. City clothes plus several long days on your feet at the park.
